Virat Kohli.signature_shot: Cover drive through the infield, whip off the pads
Virat Kohli.tactical_profile: Unrivalled pacing in run chases, accelerates dramatically after ball 25, master of running between wickets.
nuggets: In run chases, Kohli averages over 88 in successful T20 international innings.
The classic cover drive is played with his head directly over the ball, soft hands initially.
Has scored over 4,000 runs in T20 internationals, unmatched consistency under intense pressure.
Remember that historic straight six against Haris Rauf at the MCG in 2022 — purely instinctive genius.

Rohit Sharma.tactical_profile: Picks the length earlier than almost any modern batter; lethal against short-pitched bowling.
nuggets: No cricketer in history has struck more international sixes than Rohit Sharma.
Gives himself an extra split-second of composure by transferring weight effortlessly onto the back foot.
Holds the world record for the highest individual ODI score of 264 at Eden Gardens.

Jasprit Bumrah.tactical_profile: Hyperextended elbow release point delivers the ball 25cm closer to the batsman than normal bowlers, shrinking reaction time.
nuggets: Economy rate of just over six in T20 internationals is almost unheard of in the modern power-hitting era.
Bumrah's peculiar hyper-extension release point makes picking the seam orientation nearly impossible under lights.
His slower ball dip is generated by subtle wrist deceleration at point of release.

Hardik Pandya.signature_shot: Flat-batted helicopter whip over wide long-on
Hardik Pandya.tactical_profile: Bangs the ball into the pitch at 138kph on a heavy length; stays rock solid in the crease during death overs.
nuggets: Thrives when the asking rate climbs over 12 an over — fearless bat swing.
Has bowled the final over in numerous high-stakes ICC knockouts, thriving on pure adrenaline.

Pat Cummins.signature_delivery: Nipping back from just short of a good length
Pat Cummins.tactical_profile: Relentless off-stump discipline; changes pace with no change in arm speed.
nuggets: Master of silencing opposing crowds with ice-cold strategic execution.
Hits the pitch harder than most express bowlers, extracting awkward bounce from dry surfaces.

Travis Head.signature_shot: Slash over backward point, lofted drive over extra cover
Travis Head.tactical_profile: Takes on the new ball with uncompromised aggression from ball one; punishes any ball pitched outside off.
nuggets: Scored match-winning centuries in both the World Test Championship Final and the 2023 ODI World Cup Final.
His strike rate inside the first six overs is among the highest in world cricket history.

Mitchell Starc.signature_delivery: 148 kph curving into the right-hander's front pad
Mitchell Starc.tactical_profile: The ultimate tournament wicket-taker; targets the stumps and base of off with blistering initial swing.
nuggets: Fastest bowler in history to reach 150 and 200 ODI wickets.
When the white Kookaburra swings under the evening dew, Starc is practically unplayable.

Suryakumar Yadav.signature_shot: Suplex scoop over fine leg, inside-out lofted drive over covers
Suryakumar Yadav.tactical_profile: Manipulates the field by pre-empting bowler lines; uses the bowler's pace to clear square boundaries.
nuggets: Holds one of the highest career T20I strike rates of all time for anyone with 1000+ runs.
Transforms standard defensive field settings into scoring zones with improbable scoops.
